# Parker Completes Acquisition of CIRCOR’s Commercial and Defense Aerospace Business


November 24, 2026 7:30 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_610016ffd4e8f8a81288745551c95c3c/parker/news/2026-11-24_Parker_Completes_Acquisition_of_CIRCOR_s_518.pdf)


CLEVELAND, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Parker Hannifin Corporation (NYSE: PH), the global leader in motion and control technologies, today announced it has completed its previously announced acquisition of the Commercial and Defense Aerospace business of CIRCOR International, Inc. (CIRCOR Aerospace).


“CIRCOR Aerospace is a strategic addition to our aerospace and defense portfolio, and we welcome the team to Parker,” said Jenny Parmentier, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “This business adds complementary capabilities and proprietary technologies that position us to better serve our aerospace and defense customers.”


CIRCOR Aerospace designs, manufactures and supports highly engineered and proprietary flight-critical motion and flow control products for commercial aircraft and defense applications with production locations in the United States and EMEA. The business has strong OEM positions with balanced 50/50 sales across commercial and defense programs and has a positive growth profile driven by leading positions on premier programs. CIRCOR Aerospace is expected to add approximately $270 million in annual sales at more than 40% adjusted EBITDA margin and will be reported as part of the Aerospace Systems Segment.


Jay Reidy, President of Parker’s Aerospace Group, added, “The talented team at CIRCOR Aerospace will find opportunities for growth with Parker Aerospace in an industry where we both have strong pedigrees. Our businesses are complementary and our cultures are well aligned, which will allow for a smooth integration. The combination is designed to strengthen our position as a technology partner and provider of advanced systems and components that are critical for current and next generation commercial and defense platforms.”


**About Parker Hannifin**
Parker Hannifin is a Fortune 250 global leader in motion and control technologies. For more than a century the company has been enabling engineering breakthroughs that lead to a better tomorrow. Parker has increased its annual dividend per share paid to shareholders for 70 consecutive fiscal years, among the top five longest-running dividend-increase records in the S&P 500 index.
